_comment: Tier-2: contact surfaces must be SubModelParts holding CONDITIONS of a Mortar type, not Elements. Pitfall (kratos.contact #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The distinction is a registry fact and is checked both ways for three mortar names: ALMFrictionlessMortarContactCondition2D2N, ALMFrictionalMortarContactCondition2D2N and PenaltyFrictionlessMortarContactCondition2D2N all construct via CreateNewCondition, and all three raise RuntimeError 'The Element "..." is not registered!' via CreateNewElement. Checking both directions is what makes this a discrimination rather than an existence check. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 calls CreateNewCondition in the slot that is supposed to try CreateNewElement, i.e. it stops asking for mortar entities as Elements; all three then register and contact_entity_kind_mismatches rises above 0. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all three as_element[<name>]=False lines, is not registered, contact_entity_kind_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/contact_mortar_entities_are_conditions && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
